name: White Boar Gu
source: existing (Slice 1 ladder rung 1; research picked the Black Boar, which stays the Jia caravan's Gu)

name: Roaming Zombie Gu
pedia: Roaming Zombie Gu (游僵蛊) turns its user into a walking corpse that feels no pain and shrugs off blows, weaker by daylight. Used too long, the change stays.
pedia_id: Gu Zombi Pengembara (游僵蛊) mengubah penggunanya menjadi mayat berjalan yang tak merasakan sakit dan tahan pukulan, lebih lemah di siang hari. Dipakai terlalu lama, perubahan itu menetap.

name: Bone Spear Gu
source: F Bone_Spear_Gu; R ch222, 228; food: milk in canon, pork here (ADAPTED)
pedia: Bone Spear Gu (骨枪蛊) fires a small spinning spike of bone, the bone path's answer to the moon blade. In canon it drinks milk; here it eats pork.
pedia_id: Gu Tombak Tulang (骨枪蛊) menembakkan duri tulang kecil yang berputar, jawaban jalur tulang atas bilah bulan. Dalam kanon ia minum susu; di sini ia makan daging babi.

name: Blood Skull Gu
source: F Blood_Skull_Gu; R ch205, 407; food: fresh blood in canon, pork here (ADAPTED)
pedia: Blood Skull Gu (血颅蛊) drinks the blood of the slain and turns it into essence that raises its user's aptitude, one of the Blood Sea Ancestor's true inheritances.
pedia_id: Gu Tengkorak Darah (血颅蛊) meminum darah yang terbunuh dan mengubahnya menjadi esensi yang menaikkan bakat penggunanya, salah satu warisan sejati Leluhur Lautan Darah.

name: Sword Shadow Gu
pedia: Sword Shadow Gu (剑影蛊) sends out the shadow of a sword, counted among the strongest rank-three attack Gu.
pedia_id: Gu Bayangan Pedang (剑影蛊) melepaskan bayangan sebilah pedang, terhitung di antara Gu serangan tingkat tiga yang terkuat.

name: Sole Blade Gu
source: F Sole_Blade_Gu; R ch519; food: it wears its blade away in canon, jade here (ADAPTED)
pedia: Sole Blade Gu (单刀蛊) lives on a blade as a gleam of edge-light and can cut through a defence of its own rank, then needs long rest. It wears its blade away; here it eats jade.
pedia_id: Gu Bilah Tunggal (单刀蛊) hidup di sebilah golok sebagai kilau mata pisau dan mampu menembus pertahanan setingkatnya, lalu perlu istirahat panjang. Ia mengikis bilahnya; di sini ia makan giok.

name: Bronze Skin Gu
pedia: Bronze Skin Gu (铜皮蛊) coats the body in a bronze glow that turns blows aside, a close fighter's defence from the skin series.
pedia_id: Gu Kulit Perunggu (铜皮蛊) melapisi tubuh dengan cahaya perunggu yang menangkis pukulan, pertahanan petarung jarak dekat dari seri kulit.

name: Armoury Gu
source: the weapon path has no mortal Gu in canon (R ch1865, 2154; F Weapon_Path); the user's decision D2
pedia: Armoury Gu shapes its user's essence into whatever weapon the fight needs. The weapon path is young and canon names no mortal Gu for it; this one is the mod's invention.
pedia_id: Gu Gudang Senjata membentuk esensi penggunanya menjadi senjata apa pun yang dibutuhkan pertarungan. Jalur senjata masih muda dan kanon tak menyebut Gu fana untuknya; yang ini rekaan mod.

name: Killing Intent Gu
source: the killing path has only the rank-8 Kill Gu, still forming (R ch2233, 2328); the user's decision D2
pedia: Killing Intent Gu sharpens at the scent of a wounded enemy. The killing path is still forming in canon and has no mortal Gu; this one is the mod's invention.
pedia_id: Gu Niat Membunuh makin tajam saat mencium musuh yang terluka. Jalur pembunuhan masih terbentuk dalam kanon dan tak punya Gu fana; yang ini rekaan mod.

name: Fiery Claw Gu
effects: [Target Unit] takes [5] damage <upon damaging a [Military] unit>
pedia: Fiery Claw Gu (火爪蛊) hurls a great three-fingered claw of flame; several claws can merge into a bigger blaze.
pedia_id: Gu Cakar Api (火爪蛊) melontarkan cakar api besar berjari tiga; beberapa cakar dapat menyatu menjadi kobaran yang lebih besar.

name: Water Shield Gu
pedia: Water Shield Gu (水罩蛊) wraps its user in a sphere of moving water that turns blows aside; it fails only when pinned against a wall.
pedia_id: Gu Perisai Air (水罩蛊) membungkus penggunanya dalam bola air yang bergerak dan membelokkan pukulan; ia gagal hanya bila terdesak ke dinding.

name: Heavenly Essence Treasure Lotus
source: F Heavenly_Essence_Treasure_Lotus; R ch162-163 (raw: 天元宝莲)
pedia: Heavenly Essence Treasure Lotus (天元宝莲) is a flower Gu that works like a pocket spirit spring, yielding primeval stones day after day; it pays for its keeper.
pedia_id: Teratai Pusaka Esensi Langit (天元宝莲) adalah Gu bunga yang bekerja seperti mata air roh saku, menghasilkan batu primordial hari demi hari; ia membiayai pemeliharanya.

name: Gruel Mud Gu
pedia: Gruel Mud Gu (和稀泥蛊) softens earth into mud; common at low ranks, and used to raise whole towns.
pedia_id: Gu Bubur Lumpur (和稀泥蛊) melunakkan tanah menjadi lumpur; umum di tingkat rendah, dan dipakai untuk membangun kota.

name: Whirlwind Gu
pedia: Whirlwind Gu (旋风蛊) gives a short burst of speed and puts its momentum behind every strike.
pedia_id: Gu Angin Puyuh (旋风蛊) memberi ledakan kecepatan singkat dan menaruh dorongannya di balik setiap serangan.

name: Flying Cloud Gu
pedia: Flying Cloud Gu (腾云蛊) lifts its user high on a cloud: a good climber, a poor turner.
pedia_id: Gu Awan Terbang (腾云蛊) mengangkat penggunanya tinggi di atas awan: pandai menanjak, buruk berbelok.

name: Frost Demon Gu
pedia: Frost Demon Gu (霜妖蛊) turns the arm into frosty ice for a piercing palm-blade; used too often, it hurts the joints.
pedia_id: Gu Siluman Embun Beku (霜妖蛊) mengubah lengan menjadi es beku untuk bilah telapak yang menusuk; terlalu sering dipakai, ia menyakiti sendi.

name: Thunderclap Gu
pedia: Thunderclap Gu (炸雷蛊) spits a fast, bursting thunderball, but never twice in a row. One was found on a lightning wolf king.
pedia_id: Gu Guntur Meledak (炸雷蛊) menyemburkan bola guntur yang cepat dan meledak, tetapi tak pernah dua kali berturut-turut. Satu ditemukan pada raja serigala petir.

name: Poison Scorpion Gu
pedia: Poison Scorpion Gu (毒蝎蛊) stings to hold a slow poison in check: its victims need a new sting every seven days, which makes them obedient servants.
pedia_id: Gu Kalajengking Racun (毒蝎蛊) menyengat untuk menahan racun lambat: korbannya butuh sengatan baru setiap tujuh hari, yang menjadikan mereka pelayan penurut.

name: Little Light Gu
pedia: Little Light Gu (小光蛊), a famous rank-one light Gu: it lights up the area and doubles the size of a moon blade.
pedia_id: Gu Cahaya Kecil (小光蛊), Gu cahaya tingkat satu yang terkenal: ia menerangi sekitar dan menggandakan ukuran bilah bulan.

name: Shadow Follower Gu
pedia: Shadow Follower Gu (幽影随行蛊) cloaks its user in darkness; a flash of light breaks the cloak, and the Gu must rest.
pedia_id: Gu Bayang Pengiring (幽影随行蛊) menyelubungi penggunanya dalam kegelapan; kilatan cahaya memecah selubung itu, dan Gu harus beristirahat.

name: Overlapping Shadow Gu
source: F Overlapping_Shadow_Gu; R ch505, 512 (filed under the dark path; no shadow-path mortal Gu in canon; the user's decision D2)
pedia: Overlapping Shadow Gu (叠影蛊) layers shadow over shadow to strengthen an attack Gu. Canon files it under the dark path; the young shadow path borrows it here.
pedia_id: Gu Bayangan Bertumpuk (叠影蛊) menumpuk bayangan di atas bayangan untuk memperkuat Gu serangan. Kanon menggolongkannya ke jalur gelap; jalur bayangan yang masih muda meminjamnya di sini.

name: Star Dart Gu
pedia: Star Dart Gu (星镖蛊), the commonest star Gu, throws a dart of starlight; hundreds of them make a star killer move.
pedia_id: Gu Panah Bintang (星镖蛊), Gu bintang yang paling umum, melempar panah cahaya bintang; ratusan dari mereka membentuk jurus pamungkas bintang.

name: Heaven Earth Magnificent Sound Gu
source: F Heaven_Earth_Magnificent_Sound_Gu; R ch184, 186; rank 5 held at rank four until the immortal arc (ADAPTED)
pedia: Heaven Earth Magnificent Sound Gu (天地宏音蛊) looses a wide wave of sound for mass kills; long use can strip its user's voice.
pedia_id: Gu Suara Agung Langit Bumi (天地宏音蛊) melepaskan gelombang suara luas untuk pembantaian massal; pemakaian lama dapat merenggut suara penggunanya.

name: Illusory Moon Gu
source: F Illusory_Moon_Gu; R ch156 (the decoy is described, the path rests on F)
pedia: Illusory Moon Gu (幻影月蛊) makes an illusory double that draws attacks and confuses the enemy, a Gu Yue fusion of the moonlight line that eats moon orchids by the handful.
pedia_id: Gu Bulan Ilusi (幻影月蛊) menciptakan kembaran ilusi yang menarik serangan dan membingungkan musuh, leburan Gu Yue dari garis cahaya bulan yang melahap anggrek bulan segenggam demi segenggam.

name: Clear Mind Gu
pedia: Clear Mind Gu (神清蛊) enters the head like a breeze, clearing and steadying the mind for deduction.
pedia_id: Gu Pikiran Jernih (神清蛊) masuk ke kepala seperti angin sepoi, menjernihkan dan menenangkan pikiran untuk penalaran.

name: Emotion Poetry Gu
pedia: Emotion Poetry Gu (诗情蛊) stores a single emotion for later use; rare and costly.
pedia_id: Gu Puisi Perasaan (诗情蛊) menyimpan satu emosi untuk dipakai kelak; langka dan mahal.

name: Estrus Gu
source: F Estrus_Gu (enchantment); R ch415, 570 (the emotion line from which enchantment split); rank not stated (the user's decision D2)
pedia: Estrus Gu (发情蛊) bursts into a pink powder that drives beasts to breed, used to grow enslaved herds. Canon lists it in the emotion line from which enchantment split.
pedia_id: Gu Birahi (发情蛊) pecah menjadi serbuk merah muda yang mendorong binatang berkembang biak, dipakai untuk memperbanyak kawanan taklukan. Kanon mencantumkannya di garis emosi, asal jalur pesona.

name: Soul Search Gu
pedia: Soul Search Gu (搜魂蛊) reads part of a captive's memories from his soul; the results are patchy, and overuse clouds the searcher's own mind.
pedia_id: Gu Penggeledah Jiwa (搜魂蛊) membaca sebagian ingatan tawanan dari jiwanya; hasilnya tambal-sulam, dan pemakaian berlebihan mengaburkan pikiran si penggeledah.

name: Dream Pillow Gu
source: F Dream_Pillow_Gu; R ch1619; rank 5 held at rank four until the immortal arc (ADAPTED)
pedia: Dream Pillow Gu (梦枕蛊), set under the pillow, lets an ordinary Gu Master walk into his own dream realm to gather dream materials.
pedia_id: Gu Bantal Mimpi (梦枕蛊), diletakkan di bawah bantal, memungkinkan Gu Master biasa memasuki alam mimpinya sendiri untuk mengumpulkan bahan mimpi.

name: Wolf Enslavement Gu
pedia: Wolf Enslavement Gu (驭狼蛊), planted in a wolf's soul, makes it obey for life; higher ranks hold a thousand-wolf or a ten-thousand-wolf king.
pedia_id: Gu Penakluk Serigala (驭狼蛊), ditanam di jiwa serigala, membuatnya patuh seumur hidup; tingkat yang lebih tinggi menundukkan raja seribu atau sepuluh ribu serigala.

name: Man as Before Gu
source: F Man_as_Before_Gu; R ch533, 538; rank 5 held at rank four until the immortal arc (ADAPTED)
pedia: Man as Before Gu (人如故蛊) turns a body back to its state of a short while ago, a near-complete healing.
pedia_id: Gu Manusia Seperti Semula (人如故蛊) mengembalikan tubuh ke keadaannya sesaat sebelumnya, penyembuhan yang hampir sempurna.

name: Warp Gu
source: F Warp_Gu; R ch397-398; rank 5 held at rank four until the immortal arc (ADAPTED)
pedia: Warp Gu (挪移蛊) tears space to move its user's body away; frequent use twists flesh and bone.
pedia_id: Gu Pindah Ruang (挪移蛊) merobek ruang untuk memindahkan tubuh penggunanya; pemakaian yang sering memelintir daging dan tulang.

name: Amplify Effect Gu
pedia: Amplify Effect Gu (功倍蛊) multiplies the effect of another Gu, at a higher essence cost.
pedia_id: Gu Pelipat Daya (功倍蛊) melipatgandakan efek Gu lain, dengan biaya esensi yang lebih tinggi.

name: Turn Phantom Gu
source: F Turn_Phantom_Gu; R ch586; rank not stated (the user's decision D2)
pedia: Turn Phantom Gu (弄虚蛊) makes a solid thing insubstantial, so attacks pass through it. Canon does not give its rank.
pedia_id: Gu Pengubah Maya (弄虚蛊) membuat benda padat menjadi tak berwujud, sehingga serangan menembusnya. Kanon tak menyebut tingkatnya.

name: Primeval Break Gu
source: F Primeval_Break_Gu; R ch584; rank not stated (the user's decision D2)
pedia: Primeval Break Gu (断元蛊) cuts a wild Gu off from primeval energy. Canon does not give its rank.
pedia_id: Gu Pemutus Esensi (断元蛊) memutus Gu liar dari energi primordial. Kanon tak menyebut tingkatnya.

name: Luck Inspection Gu
source: F Luck_Inspection_Gu; R ch604, 611 (a series up to rank 5)
pedia: Luck Inspection Gu (察运蛊) shows the colour of a person's luck; the series reaches rank five.
pedia_id: Gu Pengamat Untung (察运蛊) memperlihatkan warna keberuntungan seseorang; serinya mencapai tingkat lima.

name: Lifespan Gu
pedia: Lifespan Gu (寿蛊) adds a set number of years of life: ten, a hundred, more. The heaven path rules them.
pedia_id: Gu Umur (寿蛊) menambah sejumlah tahun hidup: sepuluh, seratus, lebih. Jalur langit menguasainya.

name: Strength Qi Gu
pedia: Strength Qi Gu (力气蛊) is a formless qi of strength that doubles or triples its user's battle strength for a while.
pedia_id: Gu Hawa Kekuatan (力气蛊) adalah hawa kekuatan tak berwujud yang menggandakan atau melipattigakan daya tempur penggunanya untuk sementara.

name: Revert Gu
source: F Revert_Gu; R ch113, 212; rank not stated (the user's decision D2)
pedia: Revert Gu (幡然蛊) turns a fused Gu back into one of its ingredients, so a failed plan can be unpicked. Canon does not give its rank.
pedia_id: Gu Pembalik (幡然蛊) mengembalikan Gu leburan menjadi salah satu bahannya, sehingga rencana yang gagal bisa diurai. Kanon tak menyebut tingkatnya.

name: Formation Heart Gu
effects: [+10]% Strength bonus for [Military] units within [1] tiles
pedia: Formation Heart Gu (阵心蛊) is the core of a Gu formation; every other Gu in it circles around it.
pedia_id: Gu Inti Formasi (阵心蛊) adalah inti formasi Gu; setiap Gu lain di dalamnya berputar mengelilinginya.

name: Four Flavours Liquor Worm
source: R V1c121 (two Liquor Worms and four wines, sour, sweet, bitter, spicy, refine the rank-2 worm); W Liquor_Worm
pedia: Four Flavours Liquor Worm (四味酒虫), refined from two Liquor Worms and four wines (sour, sweet, bitter, spicy), does for rank-two essence what the Liquor Worm does for rank one.
pedia_id: Cacing Arak Empat Rasa (四味酒虫), dimurnikan dari dua Cacing Arak dan empat arak (asam, manis, pahit, pedas), berbuat bagi esensi tingkat dua seperti Cacing Arak bagi tingkat satu.

name: Pill Refiner Gu
source: F Pill_Refiner_Gu; R ch2284 (a human-path recipe born from the pill-path inheritance)
pedia: Pill Refiner Gu (炼丹师蛊) becomes a pill-refiner clone that refines pill Gu; canon calls it a human-path recipe born from a pill-path inheritance.
pedia_id: Gu Peramu Pil (炼丹师蛊) menjadi tiruan peramu pil yang memurnikan Gu pil; kanon menyebutnya resep jalur manusia yang lahir dari warisan jalur pil.

name: Flying Sword Letter Gu
pedia: Flying Sword Letter Gu (飞剑传书蛊) is a sword-shaped messenger that carries a letter very fast.
pedia_id: Gu Surat Pedang Terbang (飞剑传书蛊) adalah pembawa pesan berbentuk pedang yang mengantar surat dengan sangat cepat.

name: Relic Gu
pedia: Relic Gu (舍利蛊) raises a Gu Master by one small stage; there is one kind for every rank, green copper to purple crystal.
pedia_id: Gu Relik (舍利蛊) menaikkan seorang Gu Master satu tahap kecil; ada satu jenis untuk tiap tingkat, dari tembaga hijau sampai kristal ungu.

name: Painting Idea Gu
source: F Painting_Idea_Gu; R ch550 (filed under wisdom; only the name points to painting; the user's decision D2)
pedia: Painting Idea Gu (画意蛊) turns a sight into a scene etched in memory. Canon files it under wisdom; only its name points to painting.
pedia_id: Gu Gagasan Lukisan (画意蛊) mengubah pemandangan menjadi adegan yang terukir di ingatan. Kanon menggolongkannya ke jalur kebijaksanaan; hanya namanya yang menunjuk ke lukisan.

name: Plunder Gu
source: F Plunder_Gu; R ch131-138 (carried by Xiong Zhan)
pedia: Plunder Gu (强取蛊) tears a Gu away from an enemy while its user stands still; the odds are low, and failure strikes back.
pedia_id: Gu Perampas (强取蛊) merenggut Gu dari musuh sementara penggunanya berdiri diam; peluangnya kecil, dan kegagalan berbalik menyerang.
